content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip provide simple interfaces for selling digital products but limit access based on geographical location. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving creators in many regions without viable payment options. Alternatives like digital wallets or manual payment arrangements can be cumbersome and inefficient. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack enables creators to establish their online store with a full suite of tools and automatic payment processing. This stack is built on free services like Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, ensuring that creators have complete control over their sales infrastructure without dependency on traditional payment platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like PayPal and Gumroad are known for imposing strict geographical restrictions, often entirely excluding regions such as Africa and parts of Asia. Creators in these countries face a double bind: they cannot access the mainstream payment systems needed to sell their products, and alternative platforms lack the infrastructure to support their needs. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign solution that bypasses these limitations, allowing creators in restricted countries to instantly deploy a fully functional e-commerce platform. By leveraging blockchain technology for payments, COREMERCH ensures that creators can receive funds without relying on traditional banking systems that often fail them.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing through platforms like PayPal can be slow, with funds sometimes held for up to 180 days due to account suspensions. Additionally, transaction fees can accumulate, eating into the profits of creators. On the other hand, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification, charging only a 0.5% fee with no KYC requirements. This allows creators to receive payments instantly, eliminating the waiting period and reducing overhead costs. By operating on networks like BSC and Solana, which boast transaction fees under $0.10, creators can maximize their earnings while enjoying rapid payment processing.
Sovereign commerce gives creators full control over their digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One crucial difference between conventional platforms and COREMERCH is the issue of ownership and automation. With PayPal or Gumroad, users may find their accounts subject to arbitrary restrictions, jeopardizing access to funds and their products. In stark contrast, the COREMERCH model empowers creators by giving them full ownership of their digital storefronts and sales data after deployment. The Edge Commerce Stack automates payment processing and product delivery seamlessly, ensuring that creators can focus on their craft without worrying about payment interruptions or delivery issues.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture depends on your individual needs and the scale of your digital products. If you are just starting out and need a quick solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. However, for those looking to expand their offerings and require a more robust setup, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. This stack supports up to five products, includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and is fully end-to-end tested, ensuring stability and reliability. Utilize the resources available at COREMERCH to choose the best pathway for your digital business.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products by utilizing platforms that support alternative payment methods, such as cryptocurrencies. COREMERCH provides a complete infrastructure solution that enables creators to deploy their own stores without depending on traditional payment processors. This ensures that your audience can access your products without geographical barriers.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
